position_overview: Position Type: Full Time Location: Philippines (Remote) Schedule: Monday through Friday 10am -7pm ET/Wednesday through Sunday 11am -8pm ET About the Company Our client is a fast-growing waste and recycling management company based in Michigan, proudly serving major clients including Walmart and Costco. For over six years, they've provided streamlined logistics and service coordination for hauling, junk removal, portable toilet rentals, and roll-off container management. They're now expanding their operations support team with a dedicated Customer Service & Dispatcher to help ensure every completed job is verified, documented, and closed out accurately and on time. About the Role The Customer Service & Dispatcher plays a critical role in the company's daily operations, ensuring all vendor-completed jobs are verified and documented each day. This role is both vendor and customer-facing and focuses on outbound calls, email confirmations, and accurate data entry into our systems. The right candidate will be detail-oriented, proactive, and an excellent communicator with clear, fluent English. Responsibilities - Conduct outbound confirmation calls and follow-up emails with vendors to verify job completions daily. - Obtain and upload before-and-after photos for junk removal jobs via Odoo (email ticketing system). - Update job details, completion statuses, and supporting documentation in Docket (and eventually in our custom internal system). - Monitor and manage assigned tickets tagged as "confirmation required," ensuring timely follow-up and resolution. - Communicate clearly and professionally with vendors and customers to gather missing information or clarify job details. - Support miscellaneous vendor-related tasks as needed, such as onboarding vendors to new systems, collecting rate sheets, and maintaining tracking spreadsheets. - Escalate any issues or incomplete confirmations to the Operations Director or relevant internal contacts. - Identify, qualify and negotiate with vendors for Junk Removal and Dumpster Rental jobs Competencies and Qualifications Must-Have - Excellent verbal and written English communication skills - neutral, clear, and professional tone is essential - Strong attention to detail and data accuracy - Ability to multitask and manage daily call and email volumes efficiently - Experience in customer service, vendor coordination, or administrat
